list.title: Bounty Marketplace | Ninja Labs
list.description: Find paid work from Injective ecosystem sponsors, ship useful pieces, and collect on-chain proof for your Ninja portfolio.

apply.title: How it works | Ninja Labs
apply.description: Some bounties accept work directly. Others require sponsor approval before you can submit.

list.heading: Bounties
list.description: Pick up tasks posted by sponsors and submit your work. Every completed bounty adds an on-chain record.

filters.emptyBody: Try a different category or clear the search.
filters.noneBody: Sponsors have not posted any bounties yet. Check back soon.

apply.heading: How do I take part?
apply.intro: Some bounties accept direct submissions; others require sponsor approval before work starts.

submitType.heading: Submit right away
submitType.body: Finish the work, then submit it.
submitType.none: No bounties accept direct submissions right now.

applyType.heading: Apply first, then submit
applyType.body: Apply first. Once the sponsor approves you, submit your work.
applyType.none: No bounties are open for applications right now.

empty.body: New sponsor opportunities will appear in the bounty marketplace.

detail.rewardUnspecified: No reward has been specified. Approval alone does not guarantee a payout.

unspecifiedRewardSteps.record: Approval records the review result. Check the bounty terms for any reward conditions.

rewardNotes.flow: Deposit, review, then separate payout processing by the operators.
rewardNotes.token: Sent in the original token; the builder swaps if needed.

rewardNotesApply.flow: Deposit, application review, approval, submission, then separate payout processing by the operators.
rewardNotesApply.token: Reward is sent in {currency}; the builder swaps if needed.

completionSteps.transfer: After payout approval, an operator sends your reward separately.

afterApprovalSteps.unlock: Submit field unlocks for completed work.
afterApprovalSteps.reward: Final approval is followed by separate payout processing.

detail.footnote: Anyone can view. Sign in to apply or submit.

action.statusUnavailable: Your bounty status is temporarily unavailable. Please refresh and try again.
action.applySuccess: Application received. You can track it from My applications.

errors.generic: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.ALREADY_APPLIED: You already applied to this bounty.
errors.BOUNTY_NOT_OPEN: This bounty is no longer open.
errors.AGENT_SUBMISSION_REQUIRED: This bounty no longer accepts submissions.
errors.APPLICATION_NOT_APPROVED: Your application must be approved before submitting.
errors.SUBMISSION_FINALIZED: This submission has already been finalized.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the URLs and description, then try again.
errors.VALIDATION_URL: Links must be public http(s) addresses (no localhost or private addresses) and at most 2048 characters long.
errors.VALIDATION_TEXT_REQUIRED: Fill in the required text fields. They cannot be blank.
errors.VALIDATION_COMMIT_SHA: The commit SHA must be a hexadecimal git hash of 4 to 64 characters (for example 3f2a9c1). Leave it empty if you have none.
errors.VALIDATION_TOO_LONG: Something you entered is too long. Shorten it and try again.
errors.SUBMISSION_TYPE_BOUNTY: This bounty accepts direct submissions; no application is needed.
errors.DIRECT_SUBMISSION_REQUIRED: This bounty only accepts direct submissions from your account.
errors.REFRESH_UNAVAILABLE: Your session could not be refreshed. Please sign in again.
errors.UNKNOWN_ERROR: The server returned an unexpected response. Please try again.
errors.MAX_WINNERS_REACHED: This bounty has already reached its maximum number of winners.
errors.INVALID_CHARACTER: Your text contains characters that cannot be saved (for example a NUL byte). Remove them and try again.
errors.REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND: Something this request refers to no longer exists. Reload the page and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

action.applicationRejectedBody: The sponsor did not select your application for this bounty.
action.submissionApprovedBody: The sponsor approved your work for this bounty.
action.payoutAddressBody: Enter a payout address to receive your reward.
action.submissionRejectedBody: The sponsor reviewed your work and did not accept it. This submission is final.
action.submissionForfeitedBody: Your work was selected, but the reward was not paid. Reason: {reason}. Contact the admins if this is a mistake.
action.resubmitPrefilledNote: Your current submission is filled in below. Sending replaces it.
action.revisionNote: The sponsor requested a revision. Update your work and submit again.
action.inReviewNote: The sponsor is reviewing your work. You can still update it before the deadline; the latest version replaces the previous one.
action.sessionEnded: Your session has expired. What you typed is kept on this page; sign in again in a new tab, then come back to send it.
action.submitSignedOutBody: Paste the completed work link after signing in. Public visitors can still read every bounty detail.
action.applySignedOutBody: Submit a short application first. The submit button unlocks only after sponsor approval.

sessionUnavailable.title: We can't check your sign-in right now.
sessionUnavailable.body: We couldn’t reach the server. Please try again shortly.

action.closedBody: This bounty is no longer accepting applications or submissions.
action.cancelledBody: This bounty was cancelled by the sponsor, so nothing more will be reviewed or accepted on it. Applications and work that were still pending were closed with it.
action.applicationsClosedBody: The application deadline has passed, so new applications are not accepted. Applicants who were already approved can still submit until the submission deadline.
action.reviewingBody: Submissions are closed while the sponsor reviews the received work. New applications and submissions are not accepted.
action.inReviewLockedNote: The sponsor is reviewing your work. Submissions are closed, so you can update it only if the sponsor requests a revision.

unavailableBody: We couldn't reach the server. Please refresh in a moment.
